programme.desc: Puffless: Patty and Selma try to quit smoking. But when Selma relapses, an angry Patty moves in with Marge and Homer - much to Homer's dismay. Maggie befriends some animals.

programme.title: The Goldbergs
programme.desc: The Circle of Driving: First episode of the US comedy about 11-year-old Adam documenting his life in 1980s suburbia with his parents' video camera. Barry wants driving lessons.

programme.title: The Goldbergs
programme.desc: Daddy Daughter Day: A day out with Erica at the roller-skating rink leaves Murray wishing that he hadn't asked his daughter to confide in him about her life.

programme.title: Modern Family
programme.desc: Weathering Heights: Phil's excited when he's invited onto the local news. And his day gets even better when he meets his weatherman hero, Rainer Shine (guest star Nathan Fillion).

programme.title: Modern Family
programme.desc: Halloween 4: The Revenge of Rod Skyhook: Luke's Halloween party isn't going well. The Dunphys decide it needs a visit from Rod Skyhook, some promotion and adult supervision...

programme.title: Modern Family
programme.desc: Grab It!: Jay's favourite place in the world may be losing some of its charm when Phil considers becoming a member. And Claire mistakes her influence on Alex's life choices.

programme.title: Modern Family
programme.desc: Thanksgiving Jamboree: Phil spares no expense on a Thanksgiving jamboree. And Hayley has to tell her dad that she'd rather spend the holidays with her boyfriend.

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: The Star of the Backstage: Marge gets nostalgic about her days as stage manager of her high school play and reunites the cast for a re-run. They say you should never go back...

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: Bart's in Jail!: When a phone scammer who's pretending to be Bart fools Grampa into giving away $10,000, it's Homer who's the real victim. According to Homer, anyway.

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: Treehouse of Horror XXXII: Another Halloween helping of spooky tales, featuring some chilling takes on classic films including Parasite, Nightmare on Elm Street and, er, Bambi.

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: The Wayz We Were: Evergreen Terrace becomes one giant traffic jam thanks to a new GPS app. Moe reunites with an old flame - and this time he's determined to not screw it up.

programme.title: New: Hollyoaks
programme.desc: A new friendship leads Ste to relapse. Dee Dee springs into action when Nancy's health takes a turn. And a father confronts his daughter.

programme.title: Brooklyn Nine-Nine
programme.desc: Pilot: US comedy about a group of New York City police detectives. A talented but carefree detective is taken aback when a strict new captain takes over at his precinct.

programme.title: New: Ladies of London: The New...
programme.desc: ...Reign - Brand new series: Martha hosts an elegant My Fair Lady-themed picnic. Wouldn't it be loverly to have a refined, tranquil afternoon? Alas, confrontation beckons... (Ep6)

programme.title: New: Below Deck Down Under
programme.desc: Brand new series: It's time for circus night, which is pretty apt considering the amount of clowning in the crew. A heated argument breaks out in the galley.

programme.title: Gogglebox
programme.desc: Welcome to Wrexham, The Good Ship Murder, Married at First Sight UK, Coronation Street and Nadiya's Simple Spices are just some of the great TV shows up for review.
